source.limitation: Official rounded reference, not an exact conserved simulation stock. Totals and subtotals are rounded independently to ten; half-five rounds to a multiple of twenty. UK Regular excludes Gurkhas, full-time reserve and other personnel. Army trained means Phase 1; other Services trained means Phase 2. Untrained is not an unavailable/available partition. First publication 2026-04-02 explicitly documents 2026-01-01; this is not a reconstruction of information publicly known at scenario start. Salary, authorized posts, operational availability, equipment, stocks and industry remain unavailable.
